verdicts.label: L-01
verdicts.evidence: WEI_SLACK = 1000 (script L130, story 083). test_L01_plantedDust: 8-wei DOLA and 2-wei USDC V1 positions were planted, and the full preview run() passed (fork-logs/r33-test_L01_plantedDust.log). The live preview at 25981150 passes all 29 per-user bounds. Story 084 already treats L-01 as resolved by 083. Run-32 reached the same fork-refutation.

verdicts.label: L-02
verdicts.evidence: The :broadcast chain is now `forge ... && patch && npm run :verify && npm run :preview` (package.json L53). Preview runs only after verify passes, and at that point every phase gate is already satisfied on chain, so preview performs nothing. Evidence: fork-logs/anvil-preview-postverify.log shows every phase skipped. VerifyStableStakerV2Cutover never performs a step. Its live hydration path (_loadProgressFile, baselines.cutoverStartBlock round-trip, CUTOVER_START_BLOCK override, vm.eth_getLogs) was exercised end to end on an anvil mainnet fork, which closes the manifest unresolved[] item: real --broadcast -> patch -> verify PASS with 29/29 users (fork-logs/anvil-verify-clean.log). It failed correctly on a regranted V1 mint (anvil-verify-v1MintRegranted.log) and on a late start block (anvil-verify-lateStartBlock.log). The story-086 guard test_fork_v2Paused_verifierReverts was spot-reproduced and passes. The provider accepts 5000-block eth_getLogs ranges (rpc-getlogs-range-probe.txt). No path was found on which :verify is green over an incomplete cutover.
verdicts.residual: Verify can be falsely RED on a correct cutover when a V1 staker self-exits during the Migrating window. That is a new root cause, filed as NEW-02, and it is not a false-green. The standalone :preview still performs missing steps under prank by design, and its doc key now says so.

verdicts.label: L-03
verdicts.evidence: The prior note's closure condition is met. The script now asserts a simulated EYE-funded Pauser.pause() against the post-finalize registry (_assertGlobalPauseWorks('after-phase8', strict)). Live preview: GLOBAL_PAUSE|after-phase8|SUCCEEDED|registered=27 (fork-logs/preview-25981150.log). Broadcast mode and :verify add a static sweep of every registrant (unpaused, pauser == Pauser), which passed with 27 registrants. The two formerly paused registrants are no longer in the registry (26 registrants at fork block, all healthy).
verdicts.residual: The simulation runs only at 3 stages, so it misses the intra-Phase-7 window (NEW-01, separate root cause). :verify cannot simulate because it is read-only; the static sweep covers the EnforcedPause and wrong-pauser failure modes only.

verdicts.label: L-04
verdicts.proposal: fixed (for the Phase 1 -> Phase 7 V1 window this entry describes)
verdicts.evidence: test_L04_breakerAtEveryPhase1StepAndPhase simulates an EYE-funded Pauser.pause() after every Phase-1 tx and after phases 2-6. It reverts only after setPauser(OWNER) and before unregister, with 'StableStaker: only pauser'. That single-tx window is forced by Pauser.unregister's precondition and story 084 carries it forward. The pause SUCCEEDED after unregister, after pause, and after phases 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 (fork-logs/r33-test_L04_breakerAtEveryPhase1StepAndPhase.log). Story-084 resume convergence is spot-checked by test_P7W_haltedStateBroadcastResumeConverges.
verdicts.residual: Story 084's broader claim, that the breaker 'stays live for the whole Ledger session', is still false. Phase 7 opens a 3-tx EnforcedPause window (NEW-01). That is a sibling root cause (registered-while-paused), not the V1 wrong-pauser mechanism of this entry, so it is filed as new rather than as an INCOMPLETE-FIX. Triage may prefer to keep L-04 open until NEW-01 is dispositioned.

verdicts.label: F-01
verdicts.evidence: Falsification test on the real contracts at 25981150. The strategy was left 5 bps short of the shares V1's exit needs, which gives R = 1222114165887099070687 against P = 1222727602453502485450. In the single-leg shape the per-user assert reverts. In the resume/verifier shape (empty live plan) the new floor reverts with 'V2 booked total below pre-migration principal floor', while the old lockstep ('067 floor') still holds. The 1 bps case, inside the 2 bps bound, passes (fork-logs/r33-test_F01_haircut5bps_floorFailsLockstepPasses.log, r33-test_F01_haircut1bps_withinBoundPasses.log, r33-test_F01_cleanPassesBothShapes.log). The story-085 unit tests were spot-reproduced: 5/5 pass.
verdicts.residual: The floor can false-fail when a staker self-exits (NEW-02). The lockstep revert string says '!=' while the check is '>=', and the floor string still ends '(067)'. Both are story-085 carried nits and are not re-filed.

verdicts.label: Q-02
verdicts.evidence: package.json L49 `//StableStakerV2Cutover` is byte-unchanged. It still says 'pause V1', 'per-user loss <= 2 bps + 2 wei', 'V1 pauser back to Pauser and V1 UNPAUSED' and 'strategy principal >= V2 booked'. It now also contradicts story 084 (Phase-1 retire triple, V1 left paused and unregistered) and story 085 (aggregate floor; the lockstep is not a loss floor), and it never mentions :verify. Stories 084 and 086 both left it out of scope explicitly. Re-raised as a candidate with identical contract/function/rootCauseClass so it reconciles to this entry.
